meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查网页和界面的显示效果，输出截图与结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常调整界面，想快速确认外观没有变坏。
copy.tagline_en: Inspect web, terminal, or paginated UI and get a screenshot-based verdict.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you update UIs often and want to double-check appearances before sharing.

howto.what: 安装后，当你让它检查界面时，它会先截图取证，然后派两个独立检查员分别核对设计系统和实际显示，最后给你一个“通过/需修改/失败”的结论。
howto.when: 在你构建或修改任何界面（网页、终端界面、分页文档）之后，或当你问某个页面/组件看起来是否正确时触发。

say.text: 我刚改完登录页，帮我检查视觉效果是否正常。
say.note: 会截图并派两个独立检查员核对后给结论。

say.text: 这个终端界面的边框和文字有没有错位？帮我看看。
say.note: 会用真实终端渲染检查溢出和对齐。

say.text: 帮我逐页检查这份 PDF 报告的排版。
say.note: 会把每一页都转成图片逐页检查。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude will do visual QA on web/terminal/paginated UIs: capture screenshots, run two read-only reviews, and output a PASS/REVISE/FAIL verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered after you build or change any UI, or when you ask whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

say_en.text: I just changed the login page. Can you check if the visuals look right?
say_en.note: It will capture screenshots and run two reviews first.

say_en.text: Are the borders and text in this terminal UI misaligned? Please take a look.
say_en.note: It will render in a real terminal and check overflow/alignment.

say_en.text: Please check the layout of this PDF report page by page.
say_en.note: Every page will be rendered to an image and inspected.
